mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate level is a consistent positive driver of S&P 500 forward returns, such that the market interprets the current rate level as a signal of monetary policy stance that supports equity valuations, producing positive returns regardless of the absolute rate level.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 1.0% signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a federal funds rate below 1.0% and a CPIAUCSL index above 218.0 signals a monetary policy response to inflation that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% AND CPIAUCSL > 218.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a rising labor force (PAYEMS) signals improving economic conditions that support equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The housing starts level (HOUST) is a consistent positive driver of S&P 500 forward returns, such that rising housing activity signals improving economic conditions that support equity valuations, producing positive returns regardless of the absolute housing starts level.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above 800.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a weakening supply chain that increases equity risk premiums, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of rising housing starts (HOUST > 800.0) and rising retail sales (RSAFS > 360000.0) signals strong consumer demand that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 800.0 AND RSAFS > 360000.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 220.0), a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that fails to control inflation, increasing equity risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.
